 Who let criminals out?
 Letters 
 To the editor: 
 Republicans are running anti-Abdul El-Sayed advertisements saying he wants to let people out of prisons.
 Fact: During the 2024 presidential election, candidate Trump said if he was elected, he would release all the Jan. 6 criminal from prison.
